summary: Deathknell 1-6, Brill 6-11, then Undercity and the zeppelin to Orgrimmar for the Barrens (or Silverpine on the balanced route).

profTips.text: Forever: each creature can only be skinned once, so skin your own kills right away before someone else does.
Forever: every profession gets a camp object at skill 20. Push your professions to 20 early to unlock it.
Forever: crafting items to sell to vendors no longer pays (vendor prices were cut on 16 Oct). Craft for skill-ups, your own gear and other players.
Forever: healing potions are made with First Aid now, so keep your Linen Cloth for First Aid.
Forever: starter-zone Herbalism and Skinning trainers teach only the first rank. Train the next rank in your capital.

tips.general: Train level 6 before you leave Deathknell.

class.Paladin: Forever paladin: check your trainer for Undead paladin spells before you leave.

tips.general: Maggot Eye is a named Rot Hide gnoll north of Brill, near the graverobbers. Clear the gnolls around him first.
tips.tank: Pull him away from the other gnolls before you fight.
tips.healer: Drink to full and fight him alone.
tips.dps: Kill him before he gets help; use a stun or slow if he runs.

tips.speed: Speedrun: skip Silverpine and take the zeppelin to Orgrimmar; the Barrens has denser quests for 12-20.
tips.general: Delivery to Silverpine Forest: take it on the balanced route if you plan to level in Silverpine; on speedrun, skip it.

steps.objectiveText: Take Apothecary Johaan's findings to Apothecary Renferrel in Silverpine Forest.

tips.general: Run into the Undercity: hand in The Prodigal Lich to Bethor Iceshard and get the Undercity flight path from the bat handler Michael Garrett.

steps.objectiveText: Present Sevren's Orders to Bethor Iceshard in the Undercity.

tips.general: Take the zeppelin from the tower outside the Undercity to Orgrimmar, then run to the Crossroads for the Barrens route.
Balanced: follow the road south out of Tirisfal into Silverpine Forest with Delivery to Silverpine Forest.
